_comment: SHARED popup-menu modal (scenes/shared/ — Aaron 2026-08-14 ruling 2A3592D0). DECOMPOSED, not invented: a variable-length option list is a `list` with `rows_from` over ONE button prototype — the ratified data-driven-rows mechanism (read data, not code) — so no new component kind appears here. `SharedModal` expands the caller's options through `instantiate_rows` ONCE when the modal opens (a modal's options do not change while it is up), which clones the prototype per option, substitutes `{row}` / `{id}`, steps each clone's `nav_ordinal` so the d-pad walks the list in order, and publishes each row's label onto its `label_bind` key — the tree therefore ships no option copy at all. Each row fires its own id, which IS the caller's action name. Esc / pad-B fold to `modal_cancel` via the root `on_cancel` (a menu is always dismissable, like pause's `resume`). NO `behaviour` key (the manifest skips scenes/shared/); NO pair script (the params ARE the arrangement); chrome styles ride Main.scene.json's carrier through `main_scene_styles()`.
